import { readFileSync, appendFileSync, existsSync } from "node:fs";

function die(msg) { console.error("ERROR: " + msg); process.exit(2); }

function grids() {
  const lines = readFileSync(PLAN, "utf8").split("\n").filter((l) => l.trim() !== "");
  const g = {};
  for (const l of lines) {
    const eq = l.indexOf("=");

  return createHash("sha256").update(norm, "utf8").digest("hex").slice(0, 16);
}

  if (i < 0) die(`缺参数 ${name}`);
  return process.argv[i + 1];
